series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Rick discovers that beloved Uncle Steve is actually a telepathic alien parasite that implants false memories, prompting a complete quarantine lockdown when another bizarre character appears.
Prior events (Part 2): Rick locks down the house and establishes the rule of six, but an elevator flashback materializes Cousin Nicky in the living room until Rick shoots him in the shoulder.
Prior events (Part 3): A submarine flashback materializes Mr. Beauregard, unleashing a cascade of false memories that floods the house with alien parasites and corrupts Rick's own mind.
Prior events (Part 4): Rick attempts to use evidence and armed threats to root out the parasites, but a fabricated barbecue memory infects his mind and floods the locked-down house with dozens of alien imposters.
Prior events (Part 5): Rick tests Jerry's memories, but their shared vacation only deepens the suspicion that one parasite is manipulating the house.
